title: credit.expiration_changed payload v1
description: A balance row's expiry moved without its balance changing: the credits stay, their end date moves (a canceled subscription stops refilling and lets the last cycle's credits run out on their own clock). No postings.

row_id.description: The balance row (customerEntitlements) whose expiry moved.

previous_expires_at.description: Epoch ms the row expired at before; null when it had no expiry.

expires_at.description: Epoch ms the row expires at now.

refills_ended.description: The same write cleared the row's next reset: it no longer refills.

slice.description: Positions in mutation.changes that this event is made from, when one mutation is booked as several events (one per feature and plan). Absent: all of them. The mutation is always the whole one.

complete.description: Written by a handler that logs every engine command it runs (after atm 0.3.0), so a revision with no event in the log was a write of the grants row alone. Absent on what 0.3.0 wrote, which did not log some commands.
